symptom: Combo box `customEditability: never` on an association combo box passed check and exec and failed mx check with CE0463, though `widget describe combobox` lists the rule `customEditability hidden when source ≠ database` as recognised.
cause: validateWidgetVisibility (MDL-WIDGET10) judged hide rules on the statement's values and mode constants only. `source` is written from the widget's template ("context"), never stated, so the rule read as undeterminable and stayed silent — the same gap the required-property check had (#2523).
fix: fillTemplateValues gives every unset key the value exec writes from the template before either check judges a rule; the #2523 fill moved into it.
insight: Prove each new verdict against mx, controls included — the 'database mode shows it' control was itself wrong twice: a bare `datasource:` selects the ASSOCIATION mode (database mode is chosen by optionsSourceDatabaseDataSource), and in database mode the real 2.x editorConfig hides customEditability once databaseAttributeString is set. Measured on 11.16.1, one page at a time: association + customEditability CE0463, database + attribute + customEditability CE0463, database without it 0 errors — check now says the same in all three.
test: mdl/executor/widget_hidden_template_values_2522_test.go (association case refused; database-mode and unwritten controls)
